# Draft:Template:Warrant canary Dark/doc

Usage
This template is a minimally modified version of the wikipedia Warrant canary designed for improved visibility on dark mode browsers.
Just as the original template, "this template is [intended] to serve as a warrant canary for a user's Wikipedia [contributions]. This template was inspired after reading about an incident where the French government forced a Wikipedia admin to delete a page.
Parameters
The canary does not accept any parameters, though it will not turn down sunflower seeds.
